name: browser-automation
description: Automate and inspect persistent, isolated, or explicitly authorized existing Chrome-compatible browser sessions.
description_cn: 自动化并检查专用持久、临时隔离或用户明确授权的当前 Chrome 兼容浏览器会话。
workflow: Observe the page before acting when state is unknown.
Use stable element refs and execute interactions serially.
Verify state after actions and request confirmation before consequential external changes.
